provenance.origin: Metodologia autoral de pontuacao do AEGIS aplicada sobre o NIST CSF 2.0
provenance.notes: Extensoes autorais do AEGIS SOBRE o catalogo NIST CSF 2.0: (1) escala de maturidade CMMI-like de 5 niveis, que NAO corresponde aos 4 Implementation Tiers oficiais do NIST CSF 2.0; (2) pesos por subcategoria (maxScorePoints) do Aegis Score. Conteudo derivado/autoral, nunca apresentado como oficial do NIST.

maturityScale.name: Performed
maturityScale.label: Level 1: Performed
maturityScale.description: The organization may perform security practices in an ad hoc manner.

maturityScale.name: Documented
maturityScale.label: Level 2: Documented
maturityScale.description: The organization has established and documented practices related to security requirements. This documentation enables the organization to perform them in a repeatable manner and achieve expected outcomes.

maturityScale.name: Managed
maturityScale.label: Level 3: Managed
maturityScale.description: The organization reviews adherence to policies and provides adequate resources to implement and maintain security requirements.

maturityScale.name: Quantitatively Managed
maturityScale.label: Level 4: Quantitatively Managed
maturityScale.description: The organization reviews and measures practices for effectiveness. Corrective actions are taken when necessary, and higher-level management is informed of issues or status on a recurring basis.

maturityScale.name: Optimizing
maturityScale.label: Level 5: Optimizing
maturityScale.description: The organization has standardized and optimized process implementation throughout. It also communicates and shares improvement information across the organization.

nonAutomatedSubcategories.reason: Resultados de governanca organizacional (missao, apetite/estrategia de risco, papeis e politica) nao comprovaveis por telemetria de ferramenta nem por rubrica automatizavel neste pacote: avaliacao manual/atestada, ainda NAO suportada de forma automatizada. Ausencia DECLARADA e validada na prontidao, nunca esquecimento silencioso.

rulesProvenance.origin: Rubricas de avaliacao AEGIS derivadas do NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (autoral)
rulesProvenance.notes: 99 rubricas consultivas. calculation_logic e TEXTO consultivo, NAO executado por motor deterministico neste pacote. As 7 subcategorias sem regra estao em nonAutomatedSubcategories.
